$sources: AISC 360-22 Specification for Structural Steel Buildings: Chapters B-K, Appendices 2, 3 (the fatigue table), 6
source: AISC 360-22 (LRFD and ASD, Sec B3.1-B3.2); the values the pack does not give are BNBC 2020's (the pack it extends)

clauses.torsionHss: AISC 360-22 Sec H3.1, Eqs H3-1 to H3-5
clauses.builtUpSnug: AISC 360-22 Sec E6.1(a), Eq E6-1 (snug-tight bolts)
clauses.builtUpWelded: AISC 360-22 Sec E6.1(b), Eqs E6-2a, E6-2b (welded or pretensioned bolted connectors, Ki)
clauses.stiffenedShear: AISC 360-22 Sec G2.1 (kv of a stiffened web, Cv1)
clauses.stiffeners: AISC 360-22 Sec G2.3 (transverse stiffeners: Ist2 = b tw³ j; tension field panels Ist >= Ist2 + (Ist1 - Ist2) ρw)
clauses.barShear: SAEngine practice, not AISC 360-22: shear of solid bars and rounds at first yield of the peak elastic shear stress (Chapter G gives no rule for them)

sources.phi: AISC 360-22 Sec B3.1 and the limit-state sections: tension D2 (0.90 / 0.75), compression E1 (0.90), flexure F1 (0.90), shear G1 (0.90; 1.00 for webs of rolled I-shapes with h/tw <= 2.24 sqrt(E/Fy), G2.1(a)), bolts J3.6-J3.7 (0.75), bearing and tearout J3.10 (0.75), block shear J4.3 (0.75), welds J2.4 (0.75), concrete bearing J8 (0.65), anchor rods J9 as threaded parts (0.75), concentrated forces J10.1-J10.6 (0.90, 1.00, 0.75, 0.85, 0.90, panel zone 0.90), elements in shear J4.2 (yielding 1.00, rupture 0.75); HSS connections Chapter K (Tables K2.1-K2.2, K3.1-K3.2, K4.1-K4.2): chord plastification 0.90 round / 1.00 rectangular, punching shear 0.95 (round gapped K joints included), sidewall local yielding 1.00, crippling 0.75, local buckling 0.90, uneven load distribution 0.95, chord distortion 1.00, cap plates 1.00 / 0.75
sources.omega: AISC 360-22 Sec B3.2 and the limit-state sections: Ω of each φ above (1.67, 2.00, 1.50, 2.31, 1.76); slip-critical bolts J3.8 Ω 1.50 (standard holes; the hole factor hsc then gives 1.76 and 2.14); torsion H3 1.67; bracing stiffness App 6 Ω 2.00. A limit state without its own Ω: 1.5 / φ (omegaFromPhi, how AISC 360 relates them)
sources.designMethod: AISC 360-22 Sec B3.1 (LRFD) and B3.2 (ASD): the pack designs by LRFD; a project may choose ASD (Project Settings, code values: steel.designMethod)
sources.slenderness: AISC 360-22 Sec E2 and D1 user notes (KL/r preferably at most 200, L/r at most 300): SAEngine checks them as limits (SAEngine practice)
sources.netAreaMax: AISC 360-22 Sec J4.1(b): An at most 0.85 Ag of splice and gusset plates
sources.memberMethods: AISC 360-22: slender elements in compression by the effective width method of Sec E7.1 (c1, c2 of Table E7.1) and Ae of round HSS by Eq E7-6 (Sec E7.2); webs without tension field action by Cv1 of Sec G2.1 (kv = 5.34 unstiffened, Sec G2.1(b)(2)); tension field action by Sec G2.2 with the reduced form (Eq G2-8) outside the proportion limits; tees by Sec F9 (Lp, Lr of F9.2, flange local buckling F9.3, stem local buckling F9.4); flexural-torsional buckling of tees by Sec E4 (Fe of singly symmetric members); rectangular HSS lateral-torsional buckling by Sec F7.4
sources.boltGrades: AISC 360-22 Table J3.2 (SI): Fnt, Fnv of ASTM A307, Group A (F3125 Grade A325), Group B (F3125 Grade A490), N threads included / X excluded; threaded parts 0.75 Fu, 0.450 Fu (N), 0.563 Fu (X)
sources.boltAliases: SAEngine practice, not AISC: ISO property classes 8.8 and 10.9 taken as Group A and Group B
sources.pretension: AISC 360-22 Table J3.1M: minimum bolt pretension, kN
sources.slip: AISC 360-22 Sec J3.8, Eq J3-4: Rn = μ Du hf Tb ns, μ 0.30 (Class A) / 0.50 (Class B), Du 1.13, φ 1.00 standard holes, 0.85 oversized and short slots, 0.70 long slots (here hsc with φ 1.00; short slots taken as across the load: conservative); Sec J3.9 Eq J3-5a ks = 1 - Tu / (Du Tb nb)
sources.holes: AISC 360-22 Table J3.3M: standard holes; >= M36 d + 3
sources.netHoleAllowance: AISC 360-22 Sec B4.3b: the hole width + 2 mm for net areas
sources.edges: AISC 360-22 Table J3.4M: minimum edge distance from the centre of a standard hole (no distinction of sheared and rolled edges); over M36 1.25 d
sources.minSpacing: AISC 360-22 Sec J3.3: 2 2/3 d (3 d preferred)
sources.maxEdge: AISC 360-22 Sec J3.5: 12 t, at most 150 mm
sources.longJoint: AISC 360-22 Table J3.2 note: end-loaded connections with a fastener pattern longer than 950 mm along the force: Fnv x 0.833 (SAEngine applies it to the tension splices it checks)
sources.filletMax: AISC 360-22 Sec J2.2b: along edges under 6 mm the thickness, else the thickness - 2 mm
sources.concreteBearing: AISC 360-22 Sec J8, Eqs J8-1, J8-2: Pp = 0.85 f'c A1 (full area), 0.85 f'c A1 sqrt(A2/A1) <= 1.7 f'c A1; φc 0.65
sources.anchorRods: AISC 360-22 Sec J9: anchor rods as threaded parts of Table J3.2; their concrete anchorage by the anchors table (ACI 318-19 Chapter 17)
sources.methods: SAEngine practice (AISC 360 requires the effects but gives no method): prying by the T-stub method of the AISC Steel Construction Manual (Sec J3.6), the elastic method for eccentric bolt groups and weld lines, the Whitmore section (30 degrees) for gussets, plate flexure φ 0.90 Fy Z, moment bases by a rigid plate on a bearing block
sources.references: The connection notes name the AISC 360-22 sections and equations; the HSS connections by the Chapter K section and table of the limit state (Sec K2 plates on HSS, K3 HSS-to-HSS truss, K4 HSS-to-HSS moment connections, K5 welds), whose equations have the forms the notes print
sources.bracing: AISC 360-22 Appendix 6: φ 0.75 (Ω 2.00); columns relative Prb = 0.005 Pr, βbr = 2 Pr / (φ Lbr) (Sec 6.2.1), nodal Prb = 0.01 Pr, βbr = 8 Pr / (φ Lbr) (Sec 6.2.2); beams lateral relative Prb = 0.005 Mr Cd / ho, βbr = 4 Mr Cd / (φ Lbr ho) (Sec 6.3.1a), nodal Prb = 0.02 Mr Cd / ho, βbr = 10 Mr Cd / (φ Lbr ho) (Sec 6.3.1b); torsional nodal Mbr = 0.02 Mr, βT = 3.6 L Mr² / (φ n E Iyeff Cb²), βsec = 3.3 E / ho (1.5 ho tw³/12 + ts bs³/12) (Sec 6.3.2a); the brace L/r 180 is the default pack's limit (SAEngine keeps it as a flag)
sources.ponding: AISC 360-22 Appendix 2: simplified Cp + 0.9 Cs <= 0.25 and Id >= 3940 S⁴ (Sec 2.1; SI Cp = 504 Ls Lp⁴ / Ip, Cs = 504 S Ls⁴ / Is, Is of trusses and joists 15 % lower), improved by the stress indexes (0.8 Fy - fo) / fo and Figures A-2.1, A-2.2 (Sec 2.2); the digitised curves are the default pack's (the same figures)
sources.torsion: AISC 360-22 Sec H3: φT 0.90 (Ω 1.67), HSS Tn = Fcr C (H3.1), Tr <= 20 % of Tc neglected (H3.2), non-HSS Fn = Fy, 0.6 Fy, Fcr (H3.3)
sources.torsionMethods: SAEngine practice (Sec H3.3 asks for the stresses and Fcr by analysis): warping torsion of open sections; Fcr the least of the member's critical stresses
sources.builtUp: AISC 360-22 Sec E6: (Lc/r)m = √((Lc/r)o² + (a/ri)²) with snug-tight bolts (Eq E6-1); with welds or pretensioned bolts (Lc/r)o up to a/ri = 40 (Eq E6-2a), above √((Lc/r)o² + (Ki a/ri)²) (Eq E6-2b), Ki 0.50 back-to-back angles, 0.75 back-to-back channels, 0.86 other cases; Sec E6.2: K a / ri <= 3/4 of the governing slenderness, outside plates 0.75 √(E/Fy) t <= 305 mm (staggered 1.12 √(E/Fy) t <= 460 mm), lacing L/r 140 / 200, shear 2 %, tie plates (the default pack's numbers, the same)
sources.componentK: SAEngine practice: K = 1.0 for a component between connectors
sources.tensionField: AISC 360-22 Sec G2.1-G2.3: kv = 5 + 5 / (a/h)^2, 5.34 when a/h > 3.0; no tension field action in end panels or when a/h > 3.0; Eq G2-7 within the proportion limits 2 Aw / (Afc + Aft) <= 2.5, h/bf <= 6.0, Eq G2-8 outside them; stiffeners not required when h/tw <= 2.46 sqrt(E/Fy); Sec G2.3: transverse stiffeners Ist >= Ist2 = b tw³ j (b the lesser of a and h, j = 2.5 / (a/h)² - 2 >= 0.5), with tension field action Ist >= Ist2 + (Ist1 - Ist2) ρw, Ist1 = h⁴ ρst^1.3 / 40 (Fyw / E)^1.5, ρw = (Vr - Vc2) / (Vc1 - Vc2) >= 0, (b/t)st <= 0.56 √(E/Fyst); the stiffener area rule of the default pack is not used
